data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Arela is derived from the word ari, meaning 'plentiful' or 'abundant'. This name was given to goddesses of harvest and fertility, symbolizing the abundance of nature. The name Arela carries the meaning “Plentiful, abundant” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Arela usually hope their child will grow to embody plentiful, abundant and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: In the Christian context, the name Arela refers to St. Arela of Bimba, a seventh-century Saint from Spain. She was a hermit who lived a secluded life in a cave near the town of Bimba. Despite her solitary existence, she was known for her miraculous healings and answered the prayers of the sick and needy who came to her cave seeking help. The name Arela continues to be revered in Spain and among Spanish Christians as a symbol of selflessness, humility, and devotion.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Arela holds spiritual significance for Christians as a reminder of the abundant grace and love of God. It encourages believers to turn to Him in times of need and to live a life devoted to prayer, service, and compassion. The name Arela also symbolizes the abundant blessings that come from living a life rooted in faith and obedience to God.
